objective: Resolver exclusivamente los gaps detectados por Gate5D4A-R1. Identificar dependencia canonica faltante, modulo RBAC faltante, cobertura real de permisos fuente y clasificar objetos semanticos potencialmente equivalentes. Confirmar si Production Quality requiere CREATE y determinar GATE5D4B_READY. No repetir la auditoria completa. No ejecutar DDL, DML ni migraciones. No tocar Produccion. No auto-advance.

queries.name: dependency_gap
queries.sql:
SELECT
    expected.object_name,
    CASE
        WHEN o.object_id IS NULL THEN 'MISSING'
        ELSE 'PRESENT'
    END AS physical_state,
    o.type_desc
FROM (
    VALUES
        ('Sistema_Empresas'),
        ('Unidades_Negocio'),
        ('Usuario_Catalogo'),
        ('Servidores'),
        ('Usuario_Modulos'),
        ('Usuario_Acciones'),
        ('Usuario_Roles'),
        ('Usuario_PermisosRolModulo')
) expected(object_name)
LEFT JOIN sys.objects o
  ON o.schema_id = SCHEMA_ID('dbo')
 AND o.name = expected.object_name
ORDER BY expected.object_name

queries.name: rbac_module_gap
queries.sql:
SELECT
    expected.codigo_modulo,
    m.ModuloID,
    m.CodigoModulo,
    m.NombreModulo,
    m.Activo
FROM (
    VALUES
        ('tablajeria'),
        ('tablajeria.config'),
        ('auth')
) expected(codigo_modulo)
LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_Modulos m
  ON LOWER(m.CodigoModulo) = LOWER(expected.codigo_modulo)
ORDER BY expected.codigo_modulo

queries.name: rbac_permission_gaps
queries.sql:
WITH required AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (VALUES
        ('tablajeria',        'VER'),
        ('tablajeria',        'CREAR'),
        ('tablajeria',        'AUTORIZAR'),
        ('tablajeria.config', 'VER'),
        ('tablajeria.config', 'CONFIGURAR'),
        ('auth',              'ADMIN')
    ) v(CodigoModulo, CodigoAccion)
)
SELECT
    r.CodigoModulo,
    r.CodigoAccion,
    COUNT(
        CASE
            WHEN ISNULL(prm.Activo,1)=1
             AND ISNULL(prm.Permitido,0)=1
             AND ISNULL(role_row.Activo,1)=1
            THEN 1
        END
    ) AS active_allowed_role_count
FROM required r
LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_Modulos m
  ON LOWER(m.CodigoModulo)=LOWER(r.CodigoModulo)
LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_Acciones a
  ON UPPER(a.CodigoAccion)=UPPER(r.CodigoAccion)
LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_PermisosRolModulo prm
  ON prm.ModuloID=m.ModuloID
 AND prm.AccionID=a.AccionID
LEFT JOIN dbo.Usuario_Roles role_row
  ON role_row.RolID=prm.RolID
GROUP BY
    r.CodigoModulo,
    r.CodigoAccion
ORDER BY
    r.CodigoModulo,
    r.CodigoAccion

queries.name: semantic_collision_objects
queries.sql:
SELECT
    SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name,
    o.name AS object_name,
    o.type_desc
FROM sys.objects o
WHERE
       LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%production%quality%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%foto%finish%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%quality%standard%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%quality%decision%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%quality%action%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%measurement%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%evidenc%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%device%calibr%'
ORDER BY schema_name, object_name

queries.name: semantic_collision_columns
queries.sql:
SELECT
    SCHEMA_NAME(o.schema_id) AS schema_name,
    o.name AS object_name,
    c.column_id,
    c.name AS column_name,
    t.name AS data_type,
    c.max_length,
    c.is_nullable
FROM sys.objects o
JOIN sys.columns c
  ON c.object_id=o.object_id
JOIN sys.types t
  ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id
WHERE
       LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%production%quality%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%foto%finish%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%quality%standard%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%quality%decision%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%quality%action%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%measurement%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%evidenc%'
    OR LOWER(o.name) LIKE '%device%calibr%'
ORDER BY o.name, c.column_id

queries.name: production_quality_target
queries.sql:
SELECT
    name AS object_name,
    type_desc
FROM sys.objects
WHERE schema_id = SCHEMA_ID('dbo')
  AND name IN (
      'Production_Item',
      'Production_Station',
      'Production_QualityStandard',
      'Production_QualityStandardVersion',
      'Production_Measurement',
      'Production_Evidence',
      'Production_QualityDecision',
      'Production_QualityAction',
      'Production_Device',
      'Production_DeviceCalibration'
  )
ORDER BY name
